result.rationale: Verified: admin-embedding.js.es6 defines `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({})`, and embedding.hbs contains no `action="saveChanges"` (only addHost/deleteHost buttons), so it's unreferenced. Additionally, the backend `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` just re-renders the serialized @embedding without applying any params, so the endpoint is a no-op. This is a real, specific dead-code/incomplete-feature concern grounded in the diff, though not a runtime defect.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6`, the `saveChanges` action calls `this.get('embedding').update({})`, but `admin/templates/embedding.hbs` contains no button or handler that invokes `saveChanges` (only `addHost` and `deleteHost` are wired). Additionally, the server `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` just re-serializes `@embedding` without persisting anything, so the endpoint is effectively a no-op. This is unused/leftover code rather than a functional defect in the shown UI flow.
